body.statement: If Open-ended Question 7 is resolved affirmatively, then for every fixed \(0<\gamma<1\), the feasible ellipse satisfies \[\sup_{m\in\mathfrak M_6}\left|P_m\{\theta(m)\in\mathcal C_{n,m}(1-\gamma)\}-(1-\gamma)\right|\longrightarrow0.\] Plug-in estimates consistently estimate \(|D(P_m)|\), \(\sigma_{\min}(J_m)\), and \(\lambda_{\min}(S_m)\) uniformly over \(m\in\mathfrak M_6\), thereby reporting proximity to a declared strong-chart boundary without diagnosing nonidentification on the chart complement.
body.justification: Coverage, rather than asymptotic normality alone, is the operational inference guarantee for the identified query.
body.gap: Tramontano, Drton, and Etesami explicitly leave confidence intervals open; nearby cumulant papers do not give uniform chart-aware coverage.
body.consumer: The ellipse and three margins can be exposed directly in software that reports outer-coefficient estimates.
